posts.materialUpdate: Gulf News report dated 18 September adds sales opening 26 September 2026, 292 villas (45 on waterway) and AED8.5m indicated entry price to the previously sent undated pre-launch collection. Original developer price-list confirmation remains unavailable.
posts.body:
YAS RIVA RESERVE — SALES-DATE UPDATE
Aldar | Northeast Yas Island, Abu Dhabi

New details beyond our earlier pre-launch alert: Gulf News reports sales opening on 26 September 2026, with 292 four- to six-bedroom villas. It says 45 homes sit directly on the waterway, with an optional private pontoon.

Reported starting price: AED 8.5m (unconfirmed by the developer). This is a media indication, not an independently verified Aldar price list. Payment plan, booking/EOI and handover remain unverified.

Why it matters: a near-term family-villa release with a limited waterfront subset, separate from the original Yas Riva community.
Confidence: medium-high on reported project details; developer confirmation of commercial terms awaited.

https://graf.ae/launches/aldar-yas-riva-reserve/
